item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU Develops Real-Time Weld Monitoring Tech
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University has developed an AI-driven, laser melt pool system enabling real-time, micron-precise welding oversight, improving quality and cost-effectiveness in high-end manufacturing.

item.title: Vietnam: New Law Strengthens Robust E-Commerce Growth
item.description: Vietnam’s new E-Commerce Law strengthens consumer protection, tightens platform accountability and sets clearer rules to support safer, transparent and sustainable growth of the country’s rapidly expanding online market.

item.title: Singapore: Updated Digital Roadmap Strengthens Food Manufacturing
item.description: EnterpriseSG and IMDA have refreshed the Food Manufacturing Industry Digital Plan, guiding over 1,500 businesses to adopt digital and AI solutions to boost productivity, resilience and sustainable growth.

item.title: Exclusive! From Guesswork to Strategic Clarity: AI-Powered Observability for Next-Gen Performance
item.description: AI-powered observability is redefining operational resilience and decision-making, enabling organisations in Indonesia to turn digital complexity into strategic advantage and sustained performance.

item.title: Australia: Swinburne and Museums Victoria Advance STEM Education
item.description: Swinburne and Museums Victoria launch a three-year partnership to expand STEM education, innovation engagement and technology-focused public programmes.

item.title: Malaysia: PEMACU 2.0 Fast-Tracks Strategic Tech Commercialisation
item.description: PEMACU 2.0 accelerates the commercialisation of nuclear, hydrogen, biotech, advanced materials and space technologies by funding higher-readiness research and collaboration.

item.title: The Philippines: Media Literacy and Safe Digital Engagement for Youth
item.description: Youth in Pampanga have been equipped with media literacy and cybersecurity skills through the Kilos Kabataan programme, preparing them to engage safely and responsibly in digital spaces.

item.title: Hong Kong: Web3, Tokenisation, AI Shape the Future of Finance
item.description: Hong Kong is accelerating Web3, tokenisation and AI adoption through regulated innovation, expanding digital bonds, assets and banking services while safeguarding financial stability and strengthening global competitiveness.

item.title: India: 4G, 5G and Satellite Power Next-Gen Connectivity
item.description: India is accelerating digital connectivity nationwide through rural 4G expansion, secure satellite phone services and rapid 5G rollout, driving inclusion, innovation and future-ready telecommunications infrastructure.

item.title: Singapore: AI Roadmap to Build a Secure, Innovative Digital Society
item.description: Singapore is advancing its AI and digital development strategy to create a secure, innovative and globally impactful digital society, combining infrastructure, workforce capabilities, regulations and collaboration.
